```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
raw_data <- read_csv("./data/bbl_all.csv")
raw_data_1 <- read_csv("./data/bbl_match_info.csv")
```

## Score

```{r}
db_data <- raw_data |>
  
  #date
  mutate(
    match_date = format(start_date, "%d/%m/%y")
  ) |>
  relocate(match_date, .after = season) |>
  
  #remove / relocate unnecessary variables
  relocate(start_date, .after = fielder_3) |>
  select(
    -penalty,                    #NA column
    -other_wicket_type           #NA column
  ) |>
  
  #over
  mutate(
    over = floor(actual_delivery) + 1
  ) |>
  relocate(over, .after = actual_delivery) |>
  
  #rearrange important delivery variables
  relocate(
    runs_off_bat,
    extras,
    wides,
    noballs,
    byes,
    legbyes,
    wicket_type,
    .after = over
  ) |>
  
  #phase-over
  mutate(
    Phase_over = case_when(
      over <= 6 ~ "Powerplay",
      over <= 16 ~ "Mid-Game",
      over <= 20 ~ "Death"
    )
  ) |>
  relocate(Phase_over, .after = over) |>
  
  #delivery order
  arrange(start_date, match_id, innings) |>
  mutate(
    delivery_order = row_number()
  ) |>
  
  #target runs
  left_join(
    raw_data_1 |>
      select(match_id, target_runs),
    by = "match_id"
  ) |>
  relocate(target_runs, .after = innings) |>
  
  #wicket on current delivery
  mutate(
    wicket_this_ball = case_when(
      is.na(wicket_type) ~ 0,
      wicket_type == "retired hurt" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ 1
    )
  ) |>
  relocate(wicket_this_ball, .after = wicket_type) |>
  
  #runs on current delivery
  mutate(
    runs_this_ball = runs_off_bat + extras
  ) |>
  relocate(runs_this_ball, .after = wicket_this_ball) |>
  
  #rearrange main match variables
  relocate(
    innings,
    target_runs,
    ball,
    actual_delivery,
    over,
    Phase_over,
    wides,
    noballs,
    byes,
    legbyes,
    extras,
    wicket_this_ball,
    wicket_type,
    runs_off_bat,
    runs_this_ball,
    .after = match_date
  ) |>

  
  #cumulative match score
  group_by(match_id, innings) |>
  mutate(
    cumulative_runs = cumsum(runs_this_ball),
    cumulative_wickets = cumsum(wicket_this_ball),
    score = paste0(
      cumulative_runs,
      "/",
      cumulative_wickets
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  
## New code after this
  
    #phase cumulative score
  group_by(
    match_id,
    innings,
    Phase_over
  ) |>
  mutate(
    phase_runs = cumsum(runs_this_ball),
    phase_wickets = cumsum(wicket_this_ball) ## New code after this
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>

  
  #legal delivery
  mutate(
    legal_ball = case_when(
      !is.na(wides) & wides > 0 ~ 0,
      !is.na(noballs) & noballs > 0 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ 1
    )
  ) |>
  
  #cumulative legal deliveries
  group_by(
    match_id,
    innings
  ) |>
  mutate(
    cumulative_legal_balls = cumsum(legal_ball)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  
  #current team run rate
  mutate(
    team_run_rate = case_when(
      cumulative_legal_balls > 0 ~
        (cumulative_runs / cumulative_legal_balls) * 6,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

#DONE
#additional player and match-state feature engineering

db_data <- db_data |>
  mutate(
    runs_before_ball = cumulative_runs - runs_this_ball,
    wickets_before_ball = cumulative_wickets - wicket_this_ball
  ) |>
  relocate(
    runs_before_ball,
    .after = runs_this_ball
  ) |>
  relocate(
    wickets_before_ball,
    .after = wicket_this_ball
  )


#replace NA wides and no-balls with 0
db_data <- db_data |>
  mutate(
    wides = ifelse(is.na(wides), 0, wides),
    noballs = ifelse(is.na(noballs), 0, noballs)
  )
#DONE
```

```{r}
#batsman runs within the innings
db_data <- db_data |>
  group_by(
    match_id,
    innings,
    striker
  ) |>
  mutate(
    batsmen_cumulative_runs =
      cumsum(runs_off_bat),

    batsmen_runs_before_ball =
      batsmen_cumulative_runs - runs_off_bat
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  relocate(
    batsmen_runs_before_ball,
    batsmen_cumulative_runs,
    .after = score
  )

##NOT DONE
#bowler wickets and runs conceded within the innings
db_data <- db_data |>
  group_by(
    match_id,
    innings,
    bowler
  ) |>
  mutate(
    bowler_cumulative_wickets = cumsum(
      wicket_type %in% c(
        "caught",
        "bowled",
        "lbw",
        "stumped",
        "hit wicket",
        "caught and bowled"
      )
    ),

    bowler_wickets_before_ball =
      bowler_cumulative_wickets -
      (
        wicket_type %in% c(
          "caught",
          "bowled",
          "lbw",
          "stumped",
          "hit wicket",
          "caught and bowled"
        )
      ),

    bowler_cumulative_runs =
      cumsum(
        runs_off_bat +
        wides +
        noballs
      ),

    bowler_runs_before_ball =
      bowler_cumulative_runs -
      (
        runs_off_bat +
        wides +
        noballs
      )
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  relocate(
    bowler_cumulative_wickets,
    bowler_wickets_before_ball,
    bowler_cumulative_runs,
    bowler_runs_before_ball,
    .after = batsmen_cumulative_runs
  )
```

```{r}
#batsmen data
batsman_data <- db_data |>
  select(
    match_id,
    season,
    match_date,
    innings,
    target_runs,
    
    #delivery information
    over,
    ball,
    actual_delivery,
    legal_ball,
    cumulative_legal_balls,
    Phase_over,
    
    #extras
    extras,
    wides,
    noballs,
    byes,
    legbyes,
    
    #wicket information
    wicket_this_ball,
    wickets_before_ball,
    wicket_type,
    player_dismissed,
    
    #batting / scoring information
    runs_off_bat,
    runs_this_ball,
    runs_before_ball,
    cumulative_runs,
    cumulative_wickets,
    score,
    team_run_rate,
    phase_runs,
    phase_wickets,
    
    #player / team information
    batting_team,
    striker,
    non_striker,
    batsmen_cumulative_runs,
    batsmen_runs_before_ball,
    bowling_team,
    bowler,
    
    #match context
    venue,
    delivery_order
  )

#venue- batsmen stats
batsman_ground_stats <- batsman_data |>
  group_by(
    season,
    striker,
    venue
  ) |>
  summarise(
    total_runs_ground = sum(runs_off_bat, na.rm = TRUE),
    innings_at_ground = n_distinct(match_id, innings),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    average_runs_ground =
      total_runs_ground / innings_at_ground
  ) |>
  arrange(
    season,
    striker,
    desc(average_runs_ground)
  )

##batsmen against each team
batsman_opposition_stats <- batsman_data |>
  group_by(
    season,
    striker,
    bowling_team
  ) |>
  summarise(
    total_runs_opposition = sum(runs_off_bat, na.rm = TRUE),
    innings_vs_opposition = n_distinct(match_id, innings),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    average_runs_opposition =
      total_runs_opposition / innings_vs_opposition
  ) |>
  arrange(
    season,
    striker,
    desc(average_runs_opposition)
  )

##batsmen contribution against win-lose
batsman_won_lost_match <- batsman_data |>
  
  # Add winning team
  left_join(
    raw_data_1 |>
      select(match_id, winner) |>
      distinct(),
    by = "match_id"
  ) |>
  
  # Identify result
  mutate(
    match_result = case_when(
      is.na(winner) ~ NA_character_,
      batting_team == winner ~ "Won",
      batting_team != winner ~ "Lost"
    )
  ) |>
  
  # One row = one batter in one innings
  group_by(
    season,
    match_id,
    innings,
    striker,
    batting_team,
    bowling_team,
    match_result
  ) |>
  summarise(
    innings_runs = sum(runs_off_bat, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  
  arrange(
    season,
    striker,
    match_id
  )


##batsmen type of dimissals
batsman_dismissal_stats <- batsman_data |>
  filter(
    !is.na(player_dismissed),
    player_dismissed == striker
  ) |>
  group_by(
    season,
    striker,
    wicket_type
  ) |>
  summarise(
    dismissals = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(
    season,
    striker,
    desc(dismissals)
  )

```

```{r}
##batsmen innings
batsman_innings_data <- batsman_data |>
  mutate(
    batter_ball = case_when(
      wides > 0 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ 1
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(
    season,
    match_id,
    innings,
    striker
  ) |>

    balls_faced = sum(batter_ball, na.rm = TRUE),

      balls_faced > 0 ~

      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(
    striker,
    match_date,
    match_id
  )
```

## Scoring Rate

```{r}
over_scoring_rate <- db_data |>
  
  group_by(
    season,
    match_id,
    match_date,
    innings,
    batting_team,
    bowling_team,
    over,
    Phase_over
  ) |>
  
  summarise(
    
    # total runs scored in the over
    runs_in_over = sum(
      runs_this_ball,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    # number of legal deliveries in the over
    legal_balls_in_over = sum(
      legal_ball,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    # extras in the over
    extras_in_over = sum(
      extras,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    # wickets lost in the over
    wickets_in_over = sum(
      wicket_this_ball,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    bowler_name = paste(
    unique(bowler),
    collapse = ", "
    ),

    
    # cumulative team run rate at the end of this over
    cumulative_run_rate = last(
      team_run_rate
    ),
    
    # score at the end of the over
    score_over = last(
      score
    ),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  
  mutate(
    
    # scoring rate for this over only
    over_run_rate = case_when(
      
      legal_balls_in_over > 0 ~
        (runs_in_over / legal_balls_in_over) * 6,
      
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
      
    )
    
  ) |>
  
  arrange(
    season,
    match_id,
    innings,
    over
  )


```

## Wicket Probability

```{r}
# =========================================================
# WICKET ANALYSIS FEATURE ENGINEERING
# =========================================================

wicket_data <- db_data |>

  # keep only variables needed for wicket analysis
  select(
    season,
    match_id,
    match_date,
    innings,
    over,
    Phase_over,
    batting_team,
    bowling_team,
    bowler,
    wicket_this_ball,
    wicket_type,
    player_dismissed,
    score,
    cumulative_wickets,
    delivery_order
  ) |>

  # create batting context
  mutate(
    batting_situation = case_when(
      innings == 1 ~ "Batting First",
      innings == 2 ~ "Chasing",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    wicket_lost = case_when(
      wicket_this_ball == 1 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  ) |>

  # keep only actual wicket events
  filter(
    wicket_lost == 1
  ) |>

  # order properly
  arrange(
    season,
    match_id,
    innings,
    over,
    delivery_order
  )


# =========================================================
# WICKETS LOST BY OVER
# =========================================================

wicket_by_over <- wicket_data |>

  group_by(
    season,
    batting_team,
    bowling_team,
    batting_situation,
    over,
    Phase_over
  ) |>

  summarise(
    wickets_lost = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>

  arrange(
    season,
    batting_team,
    bowling_team,
    over
  )


# =========================================================
# WICKETS LOST BY PHASE
# =========================================================

wicket_by_phase <- wicket_data |>

  group_by(
    season,
    batting_team,
    bowling_team,
    batting_situation,
    Phase_over
  ) |>

  summarise(
    wickets_lost = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>

  arrange(
    season,
    batting_team,
    bowling_team,
    Phase_over
  )


# =========================================================
# WICKETS LOST BY BOWLER
# =========================================================

wicket_by_bowler <- wicket_data |>

  group_by(
    season,
    batting_team,
    bowling_team,
    batting_situation,
    bowler
  ) |>

  summarise(
    wickets_lost = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>

  arrange(
    season,
    batting_team,
    bowling_team,
    desc(wickets_lost)
  )
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# NEW PLAYER ANALYSIS FEATURE ENGINEERING
# =========================================================


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# PLAYER BALL-BY-BALL BATTING PROGRESSION
# ---------------------------------------------------------

player_batting_ball <- batsman_data |>
  filter(
    !is.na(striker)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    
    # wides do not count as balls faced
    batter_ball = case_when(
      wides > 0 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ 1
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(
    season,
    match_id,
    innings,
    batting_team,
    bowling_team,
    striker
  ) |>
  arrange(
    delivery_order,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) |>
  mutate(
    
    player_cumulative_balls =
      cumsum(batter_ball),
    
    player_cumulative_strike_rate =
      case_when(
        player_cumulative_balls > 0 ~
          (
            batsmen_cumulative_runs /
            player_cumulative_balls
          ) * 100,
        
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
  ) |>
  ungroup()


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# PLAYER PERFORMANCE AT END OF EACH OVER
# ---------------------------------------------------------

player_over_progression <- player_batting_ball |>
  group_by(
    season,
    match_id,
    match_date,
    innings,
    batting_team,
    bowling_team,
    striker,
    over,
    Phase_over
  ) |>
  summarise(
    
    runs_in_over =
      sum(
        runs_off_bat,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    balls_faced_in_over =
      sum(
        batter_ball,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    cumulative_player_runs =
      last(
        batsmen_cumulative_runs,
        order_by = delivery_order
      ),
    
    cumulative_balls_faced =
      last(
        player_cumulative_balls,
        order_by = delivery_order
      ),
    
    cumulative_strike_rate =
      last(
        player_cumulative_strike_rate,
        order_by = delivery_order
      ),
    
    team_score =
      last(
        score,
        order_by = delivery_order
      ),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(
    season,
    match_id,
    innings,
    striker,
    over
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# PLAYER DISMISSAL INFORMATION
# ---------------------------------------------------------

player_dismissal_data <- db_data |>
  filter(
    !is.na(player_dismissed),
    wicket_this_ball == 1
  ) |>
  transmute(
    season,
    match_id,
    innings,
    
    player =
      player_dismissed,
    
    dismissal_over =
      over,
    
    dismissal_ball =
      ball,
    
    dismissal_type =
      wicket_type,
    
    dismissal_team_score =
      score
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# ADD DISMISSAL INFORMATION TO PLAYER PROGRESSION
# ---------------------------------------------------------

player_over_progression <- player_over_progression |>
  left_join(
    player_dismissal_data,
    by = c(
      "season",
      "match_id",
      "innings",
      "striker" = "player"
    )
  )


# =========================================================
# PRESSURE CHASE ANALYSIS
# =========================================================


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# MATCH STATE BEFORE EACH DELIVERY IN A CHASE
# ---------------------------------------------------------

chase_player_data <- batsman_data |>
  filter(
    innings == 2,
    !is.na(target_runs),
    !is.na(striker)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    
    batter_ball = case_when(
      wides > 0 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ 1
    ),
    
    legal_balls_before_ball =
      cumulative_legal_balls -
      legal_ball,
    
    balls_remaining =
      120 -
      legal_balls_before_ball,
    
    runs_required =
      pmax(
        target_runs -
        runs_before_ball,
        0
      ),
    
    wickets_in_hand =
      10 -
      wickets_before_ball,
    
    required_run_rate =
      case_when(
        
        balls_remaining > 0 ~
          (
            runs_required /
            balls_remaining
          ) * 6,
        
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# PRESSURE CLASSIFICATION
# ---------------------------------------------------------

chase_player_data <- chase_player_data |>
  mutate(
    
    pressure_level =
      case_when(
        
        required_run_rate >= 10 &
          wickets_in_hand <= 4 ~
          "High Pressure",
        
        required_run_rate <= 8 &
          wickets_in_hand >= 6 ~
          "Low Pressure",
        
        TRUE ~
          "Medium Pressure"
      )
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# PLAYER PRESSURE PERFORMANCE BY SEASON
# ---------------------------------------------------------

player_pressure_season <- chase_player_data |>
  filter(
    pressure_level %in%
      c(
        "High Pressure",
        "Low Pressure"
      )
  ) |>
  group_by(
    season,
    batting_team,
    bowling_team,
    striker,
    pressure_level
  ) |>
  summarise(
    
    runs =
      sum(
        runs_off_bat,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    balls_faced =
      sum(
        batter_ball,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    matches =
      n_distinct(
        match_id
      ),
    
    strike_rate =
      case_when(
        
        balls_faced > 0 ~
          (
            runs /
            balls_faced
          ) * 100,
        
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(
    season,
    batting_team,
    striker,
    pressure_level
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# PLAYER PRESSURE PERFORMANCE ACROSS ALL SEASONS
# ---------------------------------------------------------

player_pressure_all_seasons <- chase_player_data |>
  filter(
    pressure_level %in%
      c(
        "High Pressure",
        "Low Pressure"
      )
  ) |>
  group_by(
    batting_team,
    bowling_team,
    striker,
    pressure_level
  ) |>
  summarise(
    
    runs =
      sum(
        runs_off_bat,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    balls_faced =
      sum(
        batter_ball,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    matches =
      n_distinct(
        match_id
      ),
    
    seasons =
      n_distinct(
        season
      ),
    
    strike_rate =
      case_when(
        
        balls_faced > 0 ~
          (
            runs /
            balls_faced
          ) * 100,
        
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(
    batting_team,
    striker,
    pressure_level
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# HIGH VS LOW PRESSURE COMPARISON
# ---------------------------------------------------------

player_pressure_comparison <- player_pressure_all_seasons |>
  select(
    batting_team,
    bowling_team,
    striker,
    pressure_level,
    runs,
    balls_faced,
    matches,
    strike_rate
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from =
      pressure_level,
    
    values_from =
      c(
        runs,
        balls_faced,
        matches,
        strike_rate
      ),
    
    names_sep = "_"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    
    strike_rate_difference =
      `strike_rate_High Pressure` -
      `strike_rate_Low Pressure`
  )
```

```{r}
second_innings_check <- db_data |>
  filter(innings == 2) |>
  group_by(
    match_id,
    season,
    batting_team,
    bowling_team,
    target_runs
  ) |>
  summarise(
    
    legal_balls_bowled =
      sum(legal_ball, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    final_runs =
      max(cumulative_runs, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    final_wickets =
      max(cumulative_wickets, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    
    target_reached =
      final_runs >= target_runs,
    
    all_out =
      final_wickets >= 10,
    
    innings_completed_normally =
      target_reached |
      all_out |
      legal_balls_bowled >= 120
  )


potential_shortened_matches <- second_innings_check |>
  filter(
    legal_balls_bowled < 120,
    target_reached == FALSE,
    all_out == FALSE
  ) |>
  arrange(
    legal_balls_bowled
  )

potential_shortened_matches
```
